tests.argsPy:
r = rng(1240)
n = 30000
L, R = [-1] * n, [-1] * n
slots = [(0, 0), (0, 1)]
for v in range(1, n):
    i = r.randrange(len(slots))
    p, s = slots[i]
    slots[i] = slots[-1]
    slots.pop()
    (L if s == 0 else R)[p] = v
    slots += [(v, 0), (v, 1)]
vals = [r.randint(-1000, 1000) for _ in range(n)]
out, q = [], [0]
for u in q:
    if u < 0:
        out.append(None)
        continue
    out.append(vals[u])
    q += [L[u], R[u]]
while out[-1] is None:
    out.pop()
args = [out]
tests.label: large: random tree, 30,000 nodes

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(1241)
L, R = [], []
def node():
    L.append(-1)
    R.append(-1)
    return len(L) - 1
def leg(k):
    if k == 0:
        return -1
    u = node()
    half = (k - 1) // 2
    L[u] = leg(half)
    R[u] = leg(k - 1 - half)
    return u
prev = -1
for i in range(990):
    u = node()
    L[u] = leg(29)
    if prev >= 0:
        R[prev] = u
    prev = u
vals = [r.randint(-1000, 1000) for _ in L]
out, q = [], [0]
for u in q:
    if u < 0:
        out.append(None)
        continue
    out.append(vals[u])
    q += [L[u], R[u]]
while out[-1] is None:
    out.pop()
args = [out]
tests.label: large: a 990-node spine with 29-node legs
